advancement.chronoly.root.title: Demigod
advancement.chronoly.root.desc: Something is going to find you eventually.
advancement.chronoly.first_monster.title: I Accidentally Vaporize My Pre-Algebra Teacher
advancement.chronoly.first_monster.desc: Kill something that should not exist. It goes about as well as you would expect.
advancement.chronoly.bronze.title: Ordinary Metal Won't Touch Them
advancement.chronoly.bronze.desc: Get hold of celestial bronze, and stop bringing a butter knife to a hellhound.
advancement.chronoly.ambrosia.title: I Eat The Food Of The Gods And Regret The Portion Size
advancement.chronoly.ambrosia.desc: Obtain ambrosia. Do not have seconds. Seriously.
advancement.chronoly.riptide.title: My Pen Is A Sword, Which Is Not A Metaphor
advancement.chronoly.riptide.desc: Hold Riptide. Try losing it. You will not manage it.
advancement.chronoly.master_bolt.title: I Am Holding The Thing Everybody Is Looking For
advancement.chronoly.master_bolt.desc: Obtain the master bolt. This is not going to go unnoticed.
advancement.chronoly.underworld.title: I Take A Very Bad Holiday
advancement.chronoly.underworld.desc: Arrive in the Underworld. Bring a coin. Everybody forgets the coin.
advancement.chronoly.olympus.title: The Six Hundredth Floor
advancement.chronoly.olympus.desc: Reach Olympus. The lift music is worse than you imagined.
advancement.chronoly.fleece.title: The Wool That Fixes Everything
advancement.chronoly.fleece.desc: Obtain the Golden Fleece, which solves one problem and creates several.
